layout.body:
Greetings! We are grateful that you decided to order from us! The UNCONDITIONAL guarantee that comes with every product we sell is for your assurance that our company is the best. To prove this, you can make use any of the listed items FREE for a month before you are required to pay a dollar. If after the first month you are still not completely satisfied with our product, all you have to do is return it. Please keep in mind that you have to either send us the required payment or give back the product within the first 30 days of receipt.
To make things even better, if you have any problem with a product within 90 days of payment, all you have to do is to call one of our agents for a return authorization. We will waste no time in exchanging the item, issuing you with full credit, or giving you back your money--it is up to you. After this time, please consult the manufacturer's warranty, supplied with every product.
For details on how to return your product, please call one of our agents at the customer service department on the toll-free number: 1-800-222-6600, any day of the week. After contacting one of our agents, please repack the product carefully in its original box and send it back to us. All return shipping charges will be paid in full by the company. Your complete pleasure as one of our satisfied customers is most important for us!

questions.stem: When does the company require payment to be made?

options.A: When an order has been made
options.B: When a product has been delivered
options.C: A week after the invoice has been received
options.D: Within a month after the delivery of an item

questions.analysis: When does the company require payment to be made? 原文依据：give back the product within the first 30 days of receipt. 在收到产品后的 30 天内付款或退货。 A：下订单时 → 错误 B：产品送达时 → 错误 C：收到发票一周后 → 错误 D：收到商品后一个月内 → 正确

questions.stem: What does the company require customers to do if their desire is to return a product?

options.B: Purchase a certain type of carton for mailing
options.C: Look closely at the manufacturer's warranty

questions.analysis: What does the company require customers to do if their desire is to return a product? 原文依据：please call one of our agents at the customer service department. 请致电客服部门的客服代表。 A：支付运费 → 错误 B：购买特定纸箱 → 错误 C：仔细查看制造商保修 → 错误 D：致电客服代表 → 正确

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT an option offered for products returned within 90 days of payment?

options.B: Offering a cash refund to the customer
options.D: Providing a voucher so another purchase can be made

questions.analysis: Which of the following is NOT an option offered for products returned within 90 days of payment? 原文依据：exchanging the item, issuing you with full credit, or giving you back your money. 换货、全额积分、退款。 A：免费修理产品 → 正确（文中没提到） B：给顾客现金退款 → 错误 C：更换产品 → 错误 D：提供购物代金券 → 错误
